## Description and Rationale

I am an individual participant with a background in machine learning and computer vision, and I completed my master’s in Computer Science at UMass Amherst. I registered for the challenge because I enjoy working on difficult perception problems where strong modeling, experimentation, and practical engineering all matter. I saw this as a good opportunity to push myself technically, explore new approaches, and benchmark my work against other strong solutions.
